typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	dStartPreviousMonth as timestamp (toTimestamp('2/1/2025')),
	sRecordStatus as string ('PR'),
	OleDBtoReconControl_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		EFFECTIVE_DATE as timestamp,
		GL_COMPANY_NBR as string,
		GL_ACCOUNT_NBR as string,
		GL_AU_NBR as string,
		AMOUNT as decimal(24,8),
		AMOUNT_CR as decimal(24,8),
		AMOUNT_DR as decimal(24,8),
		ENTERED_AMOUNT as decimal(24,8),
		ENTERED_CR as decimal(24,8),
		ENTERED_DR as decimal(24,8),
		CURRENCY_CODE as string,
		DESC1 as string,
		ATTRIBUTE7 as string,
		JE_LINE_NUM as double,
		create_dte as timestamp,
		JE_HEADER_ID as double,
		external_Reference as string,
		gmiaccnt as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> OleDBfromFACSUATGL
OleDBfromFACSUATGL derive(RiskEOM = $dStartPreviousMonth,
		RecordSts = toString($sRecordStatus),
		RiskAdjEOM = $dStartPreviousMonth) ~> DerivedColumn
OleDBfromFACSUATGL aggregate(groupBy(),
	rowcount = count(1)) ~> GLRowCount0
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		EFFECTIVE_DATE as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		JE_LINE_NUM as double,
		ATTRIBUTE1 as string,
		GL_AU_NBR as string,
		External_reference as string,
		riskMonth_Dte as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		ENTERED_DR as double,
		ENTERED_AMOUNT as double,
		ENTERED_CR as double,
		GMI_ACCOUNT as string,
		JE_HEADER_ID as double,
		Record_Status as string,
		GL_COMPANY_NBR as string,
		ATTRIBUTE7 as string,
		CURRENCY_CODE as string,
		GL_ACCOUNT_NBR as string,
		AMOUNT_DR as double,
		AMOUNT_CR as double,
		create_dte as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		AMOUNT as double,
		riskMonth_Adj_Dte as date 'dd-MM-yyyy'
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,batchSize: 10000,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		EFFECTIVE_DATE,
		JE_LINE_NUM,
		ATTRIBUTE1 = DESC1,
		GL_AU_NBR,
		External_reference = external_Reference,
		riskMonth_Dte = RiskEOM,
		ENTERED_DR,
		ENTERED_AMOUNT,
		ENTERED_CR,
		GMI_ACCOUNT = gmiaccnt,
		JE_HEADER_ID,
		Record_Status = RecordSts,
		GL_COMPANY_NBR,
		ATTRIBUTE7,
		CURRENCY_CODE,
		GL_ACCOUNT_NBR,
		AMOUNT_DR,
		AMOUNT_CR,
		create_dte,
		AMOUNT,
		riskMonth_Adj_Dte = RiskAdjEOM),
	partitionFileNames:[($OleDBtoReconControl_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OleDBtoReconControl
GLRowCount0 sink(validateSchema: false,
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	store: 'cache',
	format: 'inline',
	output: true,
	saveOrder: 1) ~> GLRowCountCACHESINK
